test_strategy: Use pytest with pytest-asyncio for unit and integration testing. Mock external services (Stripe, Sift, Kafka, Redis) using aiomock or fakeredis modules. Implement E2E tests with HTTP client (httpx) simulating calls to FastAPI endpoints. Security and performance tests executed using locust and bandit. Ensure async tests measure latency for wire transfers and check idempotency behaviors. CI pipeline enforces >80% coverage and PCI-DSS compliance verification.

test_cases.title: Create new payment successfully via POST /payments
test_cases.description: Verify that a valid payment request inserts a record, stores idempotency key, publishes event, and returns pending status.
steps: Send POST /payments with valid method, amount, idempotency_key
test_cases.expected_result: Payment record created with status 'pending' and event published to Kafka.

test_cases.title: Duplicate idempotency key handled correctly
test_cases.description: Ensure duplicate POST call with same idempotency key returns existing payment status and no new record is created.
preconditions: Existing payment created with idempotency key X
steps: Send POST /payments again with same idempotency key X
test_cases.expected_result: API returns same payment details without creating a duplicate or publishing another event.

test_cases.title: Retrieve payment successfully via GET /payments/{id}
test_cases.description: Validate retrieval of payment details including amount, method, status, timestamps.
test_cases.expected_result: Response includes valid payment details and conforms to OpenAPI schema.

test_cases.title: Handle non-existent payment ID error
test_cases.description: Ensure API returns RFC 7807 format when invalid payment ID is queried.
preconditions: Payment ID not present in database
test_cases.expected_result: Response 404 with title 'Payment Not Found' and RFC 7807 error structure.

test_cases.title: Issue full refund for completed payment
test_cases.description: Check refund creation, event publication to Kafka, and reconciliation trigger for valid refund amount.
test_cases.expected_result: Refund record created with status 'initiated', Kafka event published, reconciliation job triggered.

test_cases.title: Prevent refund exceeding original payment amount
test_cases.description: Verify API returns RFC 7807 validation error when refund amount > payment amount.
test_cases.expected_result: API returns 400 RFC 7807 error with title 'Refund amount exceeds payment'.

test_cases.title: List payments by status and date range successfully
test_cases.description: Validate pagination and filtering logic returns correct payment list.
preconditions: Multiple payments exist in various statuses
test_cases.expected_result: Paginated list includes only completed payments in date range.

test_cases.title: Reject invalid filter parameters in payment listing
test_cases.description: Ensure API returns validation error for invalid date or status filter.
test_cases.expected_result: Response 400 with RFC 7807 formatted validation error.

test_cases.title: Retry failed payment workflow
test_cases.description: Verify failed payment can be retried successfully with Kafka event publication and status transition.
test_cases.expected_result: Payment status updated to processing, event posted to Kafka.

test_cases.title: Prevent retry of non-failed payment
test_cases.description: Ensure retry endpoint returns RFC 7807 error when called on 'completed' payment.
test_cases.expected_result: Response 400 with RFC 7807 error 'Cannot retry payment'.

test_cases.title: Enforce API rate limiting per key
test_cases.description: Verify that rate limiter returns 429 after exceeding 100 requests per minute per API key.
preconditions: API configured with rate limiter middleware
steps: Send 105 requests within one minute using same x-api-key
test_cases.expected_result: Response 429 with title 'Rate limit exceeded' and RFC 7807 structure.

test_cases.title: Audit logging compliance for payment actions
test_cases.description: Confirm all payment and refund operations are logged with masked PCI data and timestamps.
steps: Check audit log entry in storage
test_cases.expected_result: Log entry contains masked sensitive fields and complies with PCI-DSS formatting.

test_data_requirements: Sample payments with various methods: credit_card, ach, wire_transfer
API keys for rate limiting tests
automation_approach: Use pytest with pytest-asyncio for async tests, coverage.py for coverage tracking, and httpx for API calls. Mock Stripe, Kafka, and Redis with fixtures. Integrate in CI pipeline using GitHub Actions running tests in Docker containers. Generate allure reports and automatically validate OpenAPI schema during build.
coverage_goals: Achieve >=90% unit test coverage on models and services, >=80% integration coverage across all endpoints including async workflows, verify PCI-DSS logging through mock audits, validate Kafka event publishing in all workflows and ensure idempotency behavior tested in at least two duplicate scenarios.
